judgement.summary: This is an ISBAR-structured portfolio whose five paper sections assemble, expose evidence, and reunite around Aoife’s move into clinical informatics. Its greatest weakness is that the main handover comparison still depends on unseen sheets, leaving its most distinctive visual evidence unresolved.
